jobs.title: Strategic Account Manager
jobs.reason: This is a B2B sales / account management role requiring demonstrated success hitting sales targets and managing strategic commercial accounts — entirely off the candidate's policy/research profile. It demands proven sales experience the candidate lacks, and the substantive work (sales, pricing, margin management) is a fundamental mismatch.

jobs.title: Human Rights Advocacy Training (Online) — Call for Applications
jobs.reason: This is a training programme for human rights defenders working in Egypt, not a paid job vacancy; it is also aimed at community actors challenging discrimination in Egypt, not a UK-based researcher. Not a live employment opening.

jobs.title: Technikerin/Techniker (w/m/d) im Referat Gebäudetechnik
jobs.reason: This is a building-services / facilities technician role requiring a German "staatlich geprüfte/r Techniker/in" or "Meister/in" qualification in electrical, automation or building-services engineering — a specific vocational qualification the candidate lacks (exclusion). The work (DDC/SPS systems, energy plant operation, HVAC) is entirely off the candidate's research/policy profile.

jobs.title: Fachhandwerkerin/Fachhandwerker (w/m/d) im Referat Gebäudetechnik
jobs.reason: This is a skilled-tradesperson role in building services (lift/elevator and access technology) requiring a completed vocational training (Ausbildung) in mechatronics or electromechanics plus several years' experience — a clear mismatch with the candidate's IR/policy profile, and excluded on the vocational-training requirement. It also requires height fitness and possible security clearance, none of which apply.

jobs.title: Archivarin/Archivar (w/m/d) im Referat ID 2 – Parlamentsarchiv –
jobs.reason: The role requires a specific completed vocational training (Berufsausbildung zum/zur Fachangestellten für Medien und Informationsdienste – Fachrichtung Archiv) which the candidate does not hold — a hard exclusion. The work is specialist archival processing, not policy/IR research, and is off-profile.

jobs.title: Project Evaluator, Kazakhstan (Remote)
jobs.reason: London-only location policy: this is a Kazakhstan-based remote role with no London option, which forces Low. It is also a senior evaluation consultancy requiring independent monitoring-and-evaluation expertise the candidate lacks.

jobs.title: Mid-term Project Evaluator, Armenia or Moldova (Remote)
jobs.reason: London-only location policy: tied to Armenia/Moldova with in-country requirement and no London option, forcing Low. It also requires established independent project-evaluation expertise the candidate does not have.

jobs.title: Call for Proposals for Civil Society Organisations in Armenia
jobs.reason: This is a call for proposals from civil society organisations, not an individual job vacancy, and is tied to Armenia with no London option. Not an applicable role for an individual candidate.

jobs.title: Editorial/Women's Rights and Protection Expert, Iraq
jobs.reason: London-only location policy: this Iraq-based role offers no London option, forcing Low. It is also an "Expert" position requiring specialist women's-rights/protection field experience and almost certainly Arabic, neither of which the candidate has.

jobs.title: Finance Officer (Grants and Compliance) – ARTICLE 19 Europe
jobs.reason: This is a finance/accounting role requiring 5-7 years of relevant finance experience plus accounting knowledge and financial systems — a hard experience and skills barrier the candidate cannot meet. The function is off-profile (finance, not policy/research), and the Netherlands location with no London option triggers the London-only hard filter.
jobs.salary: Circa EUR 54,000 gross per annum pro-rata

jobs.title: Senior Report Reviewer
jobs.reason: This is a quality-assurance / ESG audit report-reviewing role focused on responsible-sourcing compliance, not policy, IR, intelligence or research work — well off the candidate's profile. The "Senior" title and expected audit/ESG/HR-compliance experience also exceed the candidate's stage.
jobs.location: Delhi or Mumbai, India (other locations possible)

jobs.title: Human Rights Advocacy Training (Online)
jobs.reason: This is a training programme for human rights defenders working in Egypt, not a paid job opening — it is a "Call for Applications" for a course rather than an entry-level role. It is also not a London-based position. Both the non-vacancy nature and the London-only location filter force Low.

jobs.title: Lead Auditor (Aerospace)
jobs.reason: This is an aerospace management-systems audit role requiring substantial aviation/defence industry experience and specialist auditor qualifications — entirely off the candidate's IR/policy profile. "Lead Auditor" is a senior, experience-heavy role, and the candidate lacks both the sector experience and the technical/regulatory skills.

jobs.title: AKE Remote Internship Scheme — Middle East and North Africa
jobs.reason: Political and security risk analysis is core to the candidate's targets, and the level fits well. However, this is explicitly a voluntary (unpaid) internship requiring only ~10 hours/week aimed at people studying — both the unpaid status and the working-student framing trigger exclusions.

jobs.title: Investment Accounting Manager, Property
jobs.reason: This is a finance/accounting management role requiring an ACA/ACCA/CIMA qualification, which the candidate does not hold — a hard exclusion. It is entirely off-profile (investment property accounting), at manager level requiring supervisory experience.
jobs.type: Full-time (Fixed Term Contract, 1 Year Maternity Cover)

jobs.title: Learning Manager - Maternity Cover
jobs.reason: A "Manager" title implies professional experience the candidate (student/RA only) lacks, and learning/grant-foundation management sits outside the candidate's core policy/IR profile. Seniority and field both weak.

jobs.title: Trustees
jobs.reason: Trustee roles require substantial senior experience and governance standing that an MSc-stage candidate does not have. Off-profile and far above the candidate's level.

jobs.title: Climate Action Partner: Invitation to Tender
jobs.reason: This is an open tender for a commissioned organisation/contractor, not an individual entry-level vacancy. Off-profile and not an applicable job for the candidate.

jobs.title: Face to Face Fundraising Festivals and Events Manager
jobs.reason: This is a fundraising/events delivery management role, not policy or research work — outside the candidate's profile despite MSF's humanitarian context. It requires demonstrable F2F fundraising management experience, a Manager-level remit, and a full UK driving licence the candidate lacks. The "Manager" title and required hands-on fundraising track record place it well above entry-level.

jobs.title: Governance Manager 2026
jobs.reason: This is a charity-governance and compliance role in the health sector, off the candidate's IR/policy/intelligence profile, and the "Manager" title implies governance experience the candidate lacks. Field and seniority both fail the bar.
